title: Geko's Magic
description: A magic mod that adds some stuff including a new brewing-like system called Alchemy
body:
This is a magic mod.

### Features:

A book to help you, provided by modonomicon

5 new armor trim materials

Entities:
- Geckos: Cute lizards found in the overworld

Enchantments:
- Fast Reel: Increases the fishing bobbers pull velocity

Effects:
- Lizard Brain: Forces crawl mode
- Absolutely Not: Scares creepers & phantoms
- Vulnerability: Damage taken is increased

A new system similar to brewing is added, called Alchemy. It uses the new alchemy stand to make elixirs. There are 8 different elixir types: Generic, Splash, Lingering, Clear, Boring, Uninteresting, Buttered, and Diffusing. Each has a different ability.
